name: cello_ostinato
character: A single cello driving sixteenths hard from the left, bow biting the string on every beat so the pulse pushes forward instead of ticking.
description: The engine of the cue: a repeating cell of six notes on the sounding chord, in sixteenths, with a raised accent on beats one and three and a new pitch each time the chord turns.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring section 1 | the pulse that does not stop is the first carrier of pressure; a short low-string figure made of chord tones, changed on each repeat
KB soundfont-velocity-and-realism section 4 | a hard stroke is brighter, so velocity_timbre opens the bow bite on the accents; starting values
ESTIMATE: azimuth -38 deg, 2.2 m, gain -5 dB and the 8 ms overlap are starting values for a solo cello sitting close and left
